name: Intco Recycling Resources Co., Ltd.
summary: Intco Recycling Resources Co., Ltd. engages in the recycling, regeneration, and utilization of renewable plastic resources in China and internationally. It offers EPS foam compactors machines; recycled PS pellets; recycled PET products; decorative and picture frame mouldings; and picture frames and mirrors. The company was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Zibo, China.
